end.summary:
Practised making one mark for each object.
Matched marks to objects to find missing or extra items.
Corrected one-to-one marking after an initial mismatch.
Repeatedly said a spread-out row has more objects than a close row.
Did not yet explain why one-to-one matching works without number names.
end.parentNote: Asha practised one-mark-for-one-object and matching marks back to objects. Parth corrected the marking mix-up later in the lesson. They continued to think that spreading objects apart makes more of them, so at home, place the same objects in two rows—close together and spread out—and match them one by one to show that the amount stays the same.
